rules.observable: describe a design move you can point at, not a feeling
rules.no_negations: never 'no rounded corners' — measurable facts belong in entry.tokens
rules.promotion: a pending trait becomes canonical on its second entry; singletons go to meta.notes
rules.merging: when you merge a trait, always record the losing phrasing in aliases

facets.label: Texture & Surface
facets.question: What is done to the surface or the imagery?

facets.label: Color Character
facets.question: What is the palette's overall behavior?

facets.label: Typographic Device
facets.question: What specific move does the type make?

facets.label: Structure
facets.question: How is the page organized in space?

facets.label: Component Treatment
facets.question: How are buttons, cards, nav styled?

facets.label: Imagery
facets.question: What are the pictures OF, and rendered how?

facets.label: Motion
facets.question: How does it behave over time?

traits.label: halftone dot texture
traits.definition: Visible printed dot screen laid over photography or flat color.

traits.label: atkinson dither
traits.definition: 1-bit error-diffusion dithering with no grey values retained.

traits.label: paper grain
traits.definition: Faint fibrous noise over the page ground, simulating stock.

traits.label: warm paper ground
traits.definition: Page background is an off-white cream rather than pure white.

traits.label: clean white ground
traits.definition: Pure #FFF page background used as deliberate negative space.

traits.label: muted palette
traits.definition: All hues held at low saturation; no pure or neon values.

traits.label: one-bit monochrome
traits.definition: Pure black and white only, including states — invert rather than tint.

traits.label: single accent hue
traits.definition: Exactly one saturated color in an otherwise neutral page.

traits.label: serif headline color accent
traits.definition: Serif display type with one word swapped to the accent hue.

traits.label: mono utility labels
traits.definition: Small uppercase monospace used only for metadata, indices, coordinates.

traits.label: condensed sans headline
traits.definition: Narrow uppercase sans display type set large with tight leading.

traits.label: hairline rules
traits.definition: 1px lines carry the structure instead of cards, fills, or shadows.

traits.label: narrow measure column
traits.definition: Body copy held near 60-65 characters, centered on the page.

traits.label: full-bleed hero
traits.definition: Hero imagery runs past the layout edge rather than sitting inside a column.

traits.label: pill button
traits.definition: Fully-rounded CTA. The capsule shape is the move; fill may be solid, translucent or outlined. Orthogonal to fill — co-occurs with outlined-ghost-button or frosted-glass-surface.

traits.label: soft filled button
traits.definition: Low-radius filled button, no shadow, quiet weight.

traits.label: logo wall
traits.definition: Row of customer marks used as low-key social proof.

traits.label: duotone photography
traits.definition: Photographs reduced to two inks.

traits.label: voxel illustration
traits.definition: Scenes built from visible 3D cubes, diorama-style.

traits.label: archival engraving
traits.definition: 19th-century steel-engraving or etching source imagery.

traits.label: topographic line art
traits.definition: Contour-line drawing used as illustration or background structure.

traits.label: instant state change
traits.definition: No easing or transition — states flip immediately.

traits.label: ambient drift
traits.definition: Slow continuous background movement, nothing interactive.

traits.label: pastel tinted ground
traits.definition: Page ground is a soft desaturated color tint rather than white or cream. The specific hue lives in tokens.palette.

traits.label: heavy sans headline
traits.definition: Large bold grotesk display type set at tight leading, uniform stroke weight. Weight carries the emphasis instead of color, serif contrast, or condensation. Either case — upper or mixed — is the same move.

traits.label: floating ui card
traits.definition: Small fragments of real product UI composited over hero art as inline proof the thing works.

traits.label: two color inversion
traits.definition: Exactly two colors, which swap ground and ink roles section to section. The switching itself is the structure.

traits.label: oversized cropped wordmark
traits.definition: Brand wordmark set at extreme scale and cropped by the section edge, functioning as a graphic field rather than a logo.

traits.label: micro caps label
traits.definition: Very small uppercase type with wide tracking, used for eyebrows, taglines and metadata. Typeface class is incidental. Distinct from mono-utility-labels, where monospace is itself the signal.

traits.label: staggered image row
traits.definition: A row of images set at varied vertical offsets rather than a flush baseline.

traits.label: boxed arrow button
traits.definition: Zero-radius filled button whose arrow glyph sits in its own bordered box at the right edge.

traits.label: stark monochrome photo
traits.definition: Desaturated high-contrast photography, near black-and-white, subjects dressed dark against blown-out or black grounds.

traits.label: dark saturated ground
traits.definition: Page ground is a deep fully-saturated color — jewel green, oxblood, navy — rather than a neutral or pale tint. Hue lives in tokens.palette.

traits.label: multi accent palette
traits.definition: Several saturated accents in play at once, talking to each other. Distinct from single-accent-hue, which is one accent against neutral.

traits.label: image in headline
traits.definition: Small images set inline inside display type as if they were glyphs, interrupting the word run.

traits.label: high contrast display
traits.definition: Display face with pronounced thick/thin stroke contrast, set large. Serif or sans, upper or mixed case — the stroke modulation is the move. Distinct from heavy-sans-headline, whose stroke weight is uniform.

traits.label: circular icon button
traits.definition: Small perfect-circle buttons carrying a single arrow or icon, used as accents and overlaps rather than primary CTAs.

traits.label: spec row product card
traits.definition: Product card ending in a ruled row of labeled attributes — small-caps label above the value.

traits.label: annotated photo pill
traits.definition: Small pill labels floated over imagery to call out points. Distinct from floating-ui-card: decorative annotation, not fragments of real product UI.

traits.label: lifestyle photography
traits.definition: Full-color candid photographs of people using the product in a real setting.

traits.label: cutout product photo
traits.definition: Product silhouetted from its background and placed on a flat color shape.

traits.label: near black ground
traits.definition: Page ground is a neutral near-black. Distinct from dark-saturated-ground, which is a deep chromatic hue.

traits.label: iridescent accent
traits.definition: Prismatic rainbow fringing carries the only chroma on the page. Not a flat accent fill — the color is an optical artifact.

traits.label: datamosh glitch
traits.definition: RGB channel separation, pixel smearing and corrupted glyph fragments applied as a surface treatment.

traits.label: classical figure art
traits.definition: Greco-Roman or Renaissance figurative art — sculpture, painting, academic drawing — as hero imagery. Subject, not technique: can co-occur with archival-engraving.

traits.label: outlined ghost button
traits.definition: Transparent fill with a hairline border. Describes the fill treatment only — orthogonal to shape, so it co-occurs with pill-button on a rounded outlined CTA.

traits.label: saturated gradient ground
traits.definition: Page ground is a broad multi-hue gradient at high saturation. Distinct from dark-saturated-ground, which is a single deep flat hue — here the ground travels across hues and is vivid rather than dark.

traits.label: frosted glass surface
traits.definition: Translucent panel with backdrop blur, letting the content behind show through softened.

traits.label: glossy 3d render
traits.definition: High-gloss translucent 3D geometry as the dominant image, lit to show refraction and edge highlights.

traits.label: one shot intro
traits.definition: Hero animation plays once on load, eases to rest, then holds completely static. Distinct from ambient-drift, which never stops.

traits.label: segmented pill nav
traits.definition: Floating nav bar built from discrete pill-shaped items inside a rounded container, detached from the page edge.

traits.label: painterly illustration
traits.definition: Hand-painted illustration with visible brushwork and soft edges, used as environment rather than as a placed object. Distinct from glossy-3d-render and from photography.

traits.label: scroll linked motion
traits.definition: Animation driven by scroll position rather than by time. Distinct from ambient-drift (time-based, never stops) and one-shot-intro (time-based, plays once).

traits.label: graph paper grid
traits.definition: Faint ruled grid across the page ground, evoking engineering or graph paper.

traits.label: dashed route path
traits.definition: A dashed line traced across the hero connecting labelled waypoints, turning the composition into a journey diagram.

retired.label: pixel mountains and river
retired.reason: Describes the subject of one image, not a reusable design move. Folded into voxel-illustration.
